notes: All uncertainties are 1σ. Values published at 2σ have been halved. Each R is stored the way its paper prints it: 'std/FCs' is (⁴⁰Ar*/³⁹Ar_K of the standard) / (that of Fish Canyon sanidine, FCs), 'FCs/std' the inverse. R is measured in one irradiation, so it does not depend on any age or decay constant.
